keep.text: Every flight earns at least 500 miles.
Business class earns 50% more than economy.
Flights on a Saturday earn double miles.

readme_rule.why: follows the out-of-date README: at least 500 miles, business 50% more, double miles on Saturdays

business_double.why: guesses business class earns double, not 18% more

sunday_is_0.why: off by one in the weekday: takes Sunday as weekday() 0, as cron counts, so Mondays earn double

minimum_900.why: a look-alike value: rounds the minimum to 900 miles, not 911
